overview:
Grace Meng seeks another term in this Queens-based district that leans Democratic by about six points. She has raised over $2 million and holds more than $1 million on hand, while Republican Joseph Chou has raised under $3,000 and shows no outside spending on either side. No public general-election polls are available, and no expert raters have flagged the race as competitive.

Prediction markets give Meng roughly a 95 percent chance of winning, consistent with the district's lean, her incumbency advantage, and the lopsided financial picture. The forecast expects a Democratic victory by around 20 points, with uncertainty elevated only because direct polling evidence is absent.
